alwaysShowBorder.name: Always Show Border
alwaysShowBorder.hint: Always render the token's border. Overriden if a Token has 'Hide Border' checked.

borderMode.name: Border Visibility Mode
borderMode.hint: When to render the token's border. Overridden if a Token has 'Hide Border' checked.

borderPosition.name: Border Position
borderPosition.hint: Whether to render the border always in front of or behind the token artwork.

borderWidth.name: Border Width
borderWidth.hint: Specify the width of the token's border

borderBehindToken.name: Keep Border Behind Token
borderBehindToken.hint: Render the token's border behind the token instead of in front when hovering the token.

fillBorder.name: Fill Border Contents
fillBorder.hint: Add a translucent color to the token's border contents.

borderStyle.name: Border Style
borderStyle.hint: Configure the line style for the token borders

defaultHexShape.name: Default Hex Shape
defaultHexShape.hint: Use this shape for new tokens on scenes with hexagonal grids

defaultGridlessShape.name: Default Gridless Shape
defaultGridlessShape.hint: Use this shape for new tokens on scenes with no grid

swapOrientation.name: Toggle Alternate Orientation
swapOrientation.hint: Toggles orientation for controlled hex tokens.

hideBorder.label: Hide Border
hideBorder.notes: Hide the token's border. Overrides Module setting 'Always Show Border.'

hideFill.label: Hide Border Fill
hideFill.notes: Hide the token's border fill color. Overrides Module setting 'Fill Border Contents.'

hexShape.label: Hex Shape
hexShape.hint: Use this shape for new tokens on scenes with hexagonal grids instead of the global default.

gridlessShape.label: Gridless Shape
gridlessShape.hint: Use this shape for new tokens on scenes with no grid instead of the global default.
